verdict.rationale: First-party docs say you can self-host Hoppscotch on your own infrastructure with full data ownership. The Community Edition is MIT-licensed and open source, and self-hosted deployments get an admin dashboard for server configuration and user management. A community user independently confirms it can be self-hosted, and the reported SMTP magic-link bug is an isolated configuration issue, not a contradiction of self-hostability. Missing for 10: deployment/installation specifics (e.g., container setup, requirements) in the evidence; some features (SAML SSO, audit logs, and per community reports OIDC) are gated to the self-hosted Enterprise Edition; and self-hosted login is reportedly unsupported in the desktop app.
